title: 布里茨·黄铜高架
description: 黄铜机器人布里茨沉稳站在宽阔工业走道，双拳自然放松，窗光勾出胸甲、蒸汽管和厚重机械关节。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Blitzcrank is a heavy brass automaton with an enormous barrel chest, small mechanical head, glowing blue eyes, broad shoulder plates, huge segmented arms and fists, and short sturdy metal legs. Preserve the recognizable mechanical proportions and rear steam pipes, with both hands attached and relaxed. His surfaces are intact manufactured armor, not a human body or skin, and no rocket punch is deployed.
art_direction.scene: He stands still on an expansive empty factory walkway with his weight evenly distributed and one hand slightly open. A single high window casts a hard diagonal beam through the space, separating gold highlights from deep blue coarse crayon shadows. Simplified receding girders and one distant door provide scale, while a faint harmless steam plume remains a minor background accent.
art_direction.palette: brass gold, petrol blue, warm rust, window ivory
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
